svg.title: Model-Zoo
svg.desc: Model-Zoo measures the eigenvalue spectrum of every weight matrix. The figure stacks the 50 measured spectra of EleutherAI/pythia-160m, one ridge per matrix from the input embedding at the back to the output embedding at the front, on a log scale. Each ridge's tail, from its fitted cutoff, is colored by its fitted power-law exponent alpha.
svg.text: Measures the eigenvalue spectrum of every
weight matrix in a Hugging Face checkpoint,
fingerprints the same weights and publishes
the results as one queryable model zoo.
Tail color is the fitted α
